name: Keep-Levels
author: mittens4all
description: This behavior pack uses scoreboards to detect player experience levels. Experience levels are not lost after dying and remain upon respawn.

name: Vanilla MCPE Quality of Life
author: ALNStudios
description: Vanilla Quality of Life is a lightweight, pure data-driven overhaul that fixes Minecraft Bedrock’s biggest survival headaches while preserving 100% of the vanilla gameplay spirit!

name: APSD - A Pocket Storage Dimension
author: LArageboy
description: One item, a storage warehouse of over 2.5 million items, APSD Vault is a single block & fits in your hand. Place it (Overworld, Nether or End), use it, pick it up, place it again, and the same warehouse is waiting inside with everything where you left it.

name: ChopPop
author: lete114
description: A Minecraft Bedrock addon that chops down entire trees instantly when you sneak and break a single log. Supports fast leaf decay, axe enchantments, and even works on Nether stems — just hold an axe, sneak, and chop. Pop! The whole tree drops.

name: Custom Trees - Capitator and Achievements Friendly
author: LArageboy
description: Never have to go mining and get lost again! Custom trees spawn in various locations and allow for not only varied colors, but also various ores and fruits. Pack icon doesn't accurately portray the trees, they are too huge for a pic!

name: Chronos Magitech: Isekai Arcane Firearms
author: Verocrft
description: 5 arcane firearms powered by mana, each with a Sneak Overcharge ultimate. Features a smart mobile crosshair, gentle aim assist, 3D models, and survival crafting. Achievement friendly, no experimental toggles, 60 FPS.

name: Skyblock Origins
author: DimaHappy7
description: Original Skyblock brings the classic Skyblock survival challenge to Minecraft Bedrock! Start with almost nothing on a tiny floating island and see how far you can survive, expand and build.

name: Lucky Skyblock V5
author: INTOR
description: Skyblock! Conquer, build, buy and sell! Find the lucky tree and earn bonuses! Map has: 5 biomes; Jungle, Taiga, Savannah, Nether and End / shop / old lava factory / 2 spawners. This world contains 3 packs: traders, void protector and lucky blocks!

name: Mini Golems+
author: LokiMC
description: Mini Golems+ adds pocket-sized golems to Minecraft Bedrock: Mini Iron, Mini Sculk, Mini Sculk Catalyst and Mini Warden Golem. Craft a Mini Golem Head with a Mini Golem Spell and a Carved Pumpkin, then build them like a copper golem.

name: Better Sleeping
author: OrionCrow1
description: Better Sleeping gives you a random buff every time you finish sleeping, reminding you how important sleep really is.

name: 𝗣𝗶𝗰𝗸 𝘂𝗽 & 𝗖𝗮𝗿𝗿𝘆
author: sirob
description: Pick up the player, mob, or chest with items and carry it to the right place! All mobs, players and blocks with items are carryable! Even mobs or blocks from other addons!

name: Tree Capitator + Vein Miner Addon
author: Keyyard
description: This addon mod for Minecraft making resource gathering more efficient and convenient. Tired of chopping down trees block by block? Try Tree Capitator! Instantly fell entire trees with one click. And mining ore chains got you down? Use Vein Miner for instant mining! Now, both tools are combined into one. Activate them separately as needed. Gather resources faster and easier. Get the ultimate tree and ore mining tool today and enjoy effortless gameplay! Note: Always remember to use game modifications responsibly and in accordance with the game's terms and conditions.

name: The Sift Dimension | Add-On
author: trotamundos872
description: The Sift is the next great new dimension for Minecraft; this is a recreation in beta.

name: Ambi (Horror Ambience)
author: SantuYT
description: With this official AmbiMod extension, you can transform the atmosphere of your Minecraft world into one of suspense and extreme horror.

name: Asta Devil Union
author: EMasha
description: Asta Devil Union gives you a free Black Netherite Sword and grants additional abilities while you are holding it.

name: Mob Head With ability [Achievement friendly]
author: Zorrocraft1
description: Unleash the power of mobs with craftable heads, each granting unique abilities. Recipes are petty hard, so you have a motive to grant more

name: Immersive Aircraft: Bedrock Port (Official)
author: Draco12191712
description: A set of vanilla style, customizable and upgradable aircraft, from biplanes to airships. Original Java mod by Conczin

name: Amethyst Drill Pickaxe
author: SomeUnwantedFeelings
description: A clean and lightweight Minecraft Bedrock resource pack designed to improve your gameplay experience. Easy to install and compatible with Minecraft Bedrock Edition. — Made by @youngsocialsociety (TikTok)

name: Dying Drops OP Items
author: Verocrft
description: Chaotic death-reward addon for Minecraft Bedrock where every death drops random OP loot, from enchanted netherite gear to beacons and dragon eggs.

name: Lucky Block (Achievements-Friendly)
author: HowardAddon
description: Howard Lucky Block will give you random items ranging from uncommon to rare to ultra rare.

name: XP = OP
author: HumanlyInfinite
description: Every XP level turns you into a God! Unlock stacking status buffs & auto-enchanted crafting from Lvl 1 to 200. Can you reach max power?

name: Jumping Enchants
author: BebuPlayz
description: Every jump randomly enchants a random item in your inventory. Survive the chaos and defeat the Ender Dragon.

name: Lucky blocks
author: Effect99DL
description: What they've been asking for for so long, a Lucky Block addon that generates structures, mobs, drops, potion effects and much more, plus not only was one lucky block added, but seven more blocks.

name: Lucky Block Skyblock
author: NamanStudios
description: Lucky Block Skyblock is a 4-player multiplayer survival map featuring 4 unique islands. Choose your team, break Lucky Blocks, collect loot, survive, and become the ultimate champion.

name: Saiyan Block (Dragon Ball)
author: SyronStudios
description: A Dragon Ball addon featuring epic transformations, powerful abilities, intense battles, and exciting adventures.

name: Forgotten Giantlands
author: ndnhyd
description: The portal to the dimension is a 5 by 5 upright square that you light with a wither rose made of Glitchstone, which is like a pink version of glowstone that occurs in clumps of 9 to 27 blocks across all dimensions. the dimension is called the Forgotten lands, where there are islands floating everywhere, suspended above the void. All the leaves, trees and wood and even grass are grey. The only mob is the Giant, like a giant zombie around 20 blocks tall that attacks the player. no ores spawn except coal, quartz ore and ancient debris. The quartz ore, instead of looking like netherrack surrounding it, looks like it has stone instead. Structures like huge spirals made of glitchstone occur commonly here.

name: Brainrot Realm
author: bobiscool12322
description: make a dimension that is a brainrot dimension and when you get in it there is tung tung tung and 67 kid and the 67 brainrot and a lot more brainrots

name: The one who watches
author: 00thegman
description: A pale watcher stalks the night, hunting anyone who dares look its way.
